subject: PO pre-auth, discount gating, and monthly invoice lane for renewal
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify PO requirements & discount eligibility for upcoming renewal

Hi Marissa,

We're getting the procurement paperwork together for our renewal and have a couple of gating questions before we issue the PO:

- Greenfield requires monthly invoicing (we bill monthly into our ERP) with Net45 payment terms. Will Redwood accept monthly invoices tied to a single blanket PO, or do you require separate POs per invoice/billing lane?
- Our finance team needs the PO to reference the Master Subscription Agreement and include line items that map to your pricing buckets so discounts apply. Can discounts be honored at the account level if the PO references the MSA and contains the commitment buckets?
- Any mandatory PO fields we should include (vendor legal name, tax ID, routing code, remit address, invoice reference fields, etc.)?

Attached is our standard draft PO template for reference (we can change formatting if needed). If you can confirm what's required on your side we can get procurement to issue the PO this week.

Thanks —
Samantha
Samantha Price
Sr. Procurement Manager, Greenfield Health
Attachment: draft_po_gfh_20270817.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify PO requirements & discount eligibility for upcoming renewal

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the template and the clear questions. Quick answers and next steps below. I'll keep this high level and loop Vivek for finance sign-off on the Net45.

1) Monthly invoices against a single blanket PO: yes, we can accept monthly invoices tied to one blanket PO. The PO must include either the Master Subscription Agreement number or the Redwood SOW reference so we can map invoices to the committed buckets.

2) Discount gating / eligibility: discounts are calculated based on committed spend over the quarter. We can honor the tiered discount if the PO explicitly lists the commitment buckets (e.g., Q3 commitment: $X) OR if the PO references the MSA and includes a bill-to/account-level commitment note. In short: account-level consolidation is fine, but the PO needs clear linkage to the commitment.

3) Mandatory PO fields: vendor legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Redwood tax ID: 98-7654321, remit address: 123 Redwood Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107. Required PO metadata: Billing_Lane (Monthly), Invoice_Reference (Subscription-ID or PO line reference), Entity_Code (if you have multiple GLs). Also include the MSA number under "Contract Reference."

I've attached a short PO acceptance checklist and our current pricing buckets for Q3 so your team can map lines. Vivek — can you confirm finance is able to accept Net45 for Greenfield here (they're an enterprise account)? If so we'll proceed on the PO.

Next step: Samantha, if you can send the signed PO or a sample formatted per the checklist, we can confirm discount application and schedule first invoice.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: po_acceptance_checklist.pdf (pdf); redwood_pricing_bucket_2027Q3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarify PO requirements & discount eligibility for upcoming renewal

Hi all — quick finance note from Redwood's AP/Receivable side:

- Net45: We can approve Net45 for Greenfield given enterprise status and the commitment in the MSA; this requires an internal credit approval I will process immediately.
- Required PO fields we need to see: Vendor Legal Name, Vendor Tax ID (Marissa listed), PO Number, Billing_Lane (Monthly), Invoice_Reference (Subscription-ID or UUID), Remit Address, and AP Contact Email. Please include an ERP code if your system requires it (Entity_Code).
- Discount: Finance can honor the tiered discount at account level provided the PO references the MSA and includes the commitment bucket or commitment amount and dates. We will reconcile monthly invoices against the blanket PO and apply the discount at invoice reconciliation time.

I've attached AP routing and our preferred invoice XML/CSV mapping for your ERP team to use. Marissa, I've kicked off the credit approval; should be complete by EOD.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Marissa/Vivek —

Thanks, everyone — that all helps. Attaching the signed PO now; we've added the MSA reference, Billing_Lane: Monthly, and included subscription IDs on each line. Please confirm when the first invoice will be generated (we expect it within 30 days of the PO date) and whether any early-pay credits apply if we pay before Net45.

Also can you send the DocuSign link for the SOW change (Tom and I will sign that after procurement finishes the PO)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samantha
